### 2026-11-07: 7:00 - 2:00

**7h**

7:00 - 2:00
- Continued working on pcb
- Learnt that pumps require 2 pin connectors (pwr and gnd)
- learnt that moisture sensors require 3 pin connectors (pwr, gnd, and info output)
- removed a battery because i ran out of space on the 100x100mm pcb board (might just hook up a battery source to the esp32's usbc port anyways)
- learnt that float sensors require 2 pin connectors (its technically a switch)
- Added a bunch of stuff to regulate current and voltage to avoid frying the pcb
- get lost trying to make the battery safe (for so freaking long)
- try to remake the pcb schematic to be better but don't understand how
- after all this confusion, its 12:00 and all i made was a battery protection circuit (this is getting way too complex and out of hand for my little experience)
- reorganized esp32 c3
- pretty much revamped original schematic design
- realized that MT3608 boost converter needs more components
- added such components into complicated diagram thingie
- might be done schematic tho 90% sure its buggy because this project was too big of a bite lwk
- updated footprints and 3d models to fit current schematic
- i can't believe i didn't do wiring this session
- will do wiring next session as well as code (im running out of time)

### 2026-11-08: 6:00 - 11:00

**5h**

6:00 - 11:00

- Writing arduino code for pcb
- made OLED display show the plant name, moisture percentage, watering status, and a plant bitmap where the interior fills according to the measured soil moisture.
- watering status includes:
- WATER EMPTY
- PUMP ON
- SOIL DRY
- SOIL OK
- the code first assigns the pins, sets the resolution for the oled display, and sets the pump to off
- the soil sensor is read ten times and averaged
- value is turned into percentage based on example values (will edit to be more accurate when building)
- ADC value near 3000 means 0% moisture
- ADC value near 1300 means 100% moisture
- lower readings mean wetter soil
- if the float switch becomes low, there is water and it functions
- if the switch is high, it stops the pump, because there is no more water to pump
- the pump starts when the soil is at or below 30% moisture
- then it stops when moisture is above 55%
- stop if the water reservoir is empty
- stop if the pump has run for 15 seconds
- do not start again until the cooldown period has ended (10 minutes)
- in void() loop:
- determines whether water is available
- measures soil moisture
- decides whether the pump should start or stop
- refreshes the display once per second
- wait before repeating
- for bitmap, bit 0 represents a plant pixel
- bit 1 represents background
- if any neighboring pixel is background, the current pixel is considered part of the outline.
- allows for an outline when the plant indicator is full
- the outline is always white
- the interior below the moisture line is white
- the interior above the moisture line stays black
- on startup, the OLED displays a short welcome screen
- btw my plant's name is dusty, thats why you see it in the code
- added gnd fills to pcb design bcz i remembered at the last second
